topic: SourceMind autonomous mastery course generation from multiple source materials
rubric: Pass only if the implementation can ingest multiple materials, create a coherent course/book outline from source order, derive core competencies with prerequisites, map lessons to one or more competencies, show mastery progress toward 100 percent, generate teaching lessons in the background with retry/progress, and expose a student-facing course/book UI that is useful for learning rather than quote browsing. Evidence must include focused backend tests and frontend type/build validation where safe.
critic_command: Review the implemented SourceMind course generation system against the rubric and fail if lesson splitting is still based on random PDF numeric lines, if competencies are not visible, if lessons do not teach concepts, or if regeneration/background progress is not wired.
